label: before
policy: Seven origin cohorts; adult occupational/royal role assigned once at eighteen; artisan professions rotate across craft, trade, medicine, law and entertainment. One quarter free, three quarters Premium. Two work actions, rest below 75 health, deterministic hash choice policy, peaceful RPG resolution. Actual mortality; no invulnerability. Availability sampled only when a cohort survives to the stated age.

samples.cause: Died of a winter chill and a tired heart.

history.text: You arrive beneath painted ancestors. Thomas promises to preserve their land; Mabel quietly sells a jewel to pay the wet nurse. The family retains its noble standing, but debts have emptied the purse available for tutors.
😈 From the cradle you are Heathen. Skips chapel, questions everything, sleeps fine.
